launcher.notes: KINETRIX LAUNCHER 3.0.1 - THE KINETRIX LOADING SCREEN, FROM THE FIRST LAUNCH. Every instance now shows the branded Kinetrix loading screen (logo + wordmark + real mod-loading progress bars) from its very first start: before each launch the launcher lifts the splash art out of the installed client jar and writes the splash palette, and the stock Forge default that used to block the branding on existing installs is now recognized and replaced (your own custom splash art is still left alone). Everything from 3.0.0 is unchanged: all Minecraft versions with Forge or Fabric, Modrinth + CurseForge mod browser, Modrinth profile import, Microsoft sign-in, cosmetics locker, crash doctor and auto-update.

notes: Kinetrix Client 3.13.0 - GLASS SERVER SELECTOR + LOADING SCREEN FIX. The multiplayer server selector is rebuilt around a large centered frosted-glass panel: the Kinetrix logo beside the Multiplayer title with live server/online stats, refresh, a thin divider, glass search field + Direct Connect, and taller flat glass server cards with icon, name, MOTD, status dot (Online/Checking/Offline), player count, ms ping, supported version tag and neutral grey Join buttons - blue now stays with the logo and the selection accent only. A small GUI v3.13.0 tag sits bottom-left. Search filters live; double-click joins, right-click offers Join/Edit/Remove. PLUS a loading screen fix: installs that never saw the branded Kinetrix loading screen (Forge writes a default splash config on first boot that the client then refused to overwrite) get it from the next launch, with new transparent splash art and a Kinetrix corner mark instead of the forge anvil.
